decisions.proposed_text: Giá trị liên kết dễ tăng hơn khi huấn luyện,\nmức tăng lớn hơn khi huấn luyện cùng Chủ tịch
decisions.reason: The current wording is semantically correct but awkwardly repeats tăng thêm nhiều hơn; revise for natural Vietnamese while preserving meaning.
decisions.terminology_basis: No locked/community term is implicated for this item; revision is fluency-only.

decisions.proposed_text: Tổng giá trị liên kết của Support Card trong đội hình càng cao,\nTraining Effectiveness càng tăng
decisions.reason: Support Card and Training Effectiveness are canonical player-facing labels in this support-effect context.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community/source-bridge terms require Support Card and Training Effectiveness.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt 100 trở lên,\nStamina Bonus & Guts Bonus
decisions.reason: Support-effect category 155 requires the canonical Bonus labels rather than translated Thưởng labels.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded terms require Stamina Bonus and Guts Bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Tùy số Skill tăng Speed đang có (tối đa 3),\nSpeed Bonus
decisions.reason: Support-effect category 155 requires the canonical Speed Bonus label.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded terms require Speed, Skill and Speed Bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt 80 trở lên,\nWit Bonus & Skill Pt Bonus
decisions.reason: Support-effect category 155 requires the canonical Wit Bonus and Skill Pt Bonus labels rather than translated Thưởng labels.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded terms require Wit, Skill Pt, Wit Bonus and Skill Pt Bonus.
